+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+weekday_order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+by_year = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           dayname(crash_date) AS day_of_week,
+           COUNT(*) AS crashes
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY 1, 2
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+by_year["day_of_week"] = pd.Categorical(by_year["day_of_week"], weekday_order, ordered=True)
+
+# Option 1: pooled crash volume.
+pooled = by_year.groupby("day_of_week", observed=False)["crashes"].sum().reindex(weekday_order).rename_axis("day_of_week").reset_index()
+pooled["share_of_all_crashes_pct"] = pooled["crashes"] / pooled["crashes"].sum() * 100
+pooled.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+bars = ax.bar(pooled["day_of_week"], pooled["crashes"], color="#3f78a8")
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{x:,.0f}" for x in pooled["crashes"]], padding=3, fontsize=8)
+ax.set_title("NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+ax.set_ylim(0, pooled["crashes"].max() * 1.13)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: average per calendar date of each weekday.
+exposure = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT dayname(d::DATE) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS calendar_days
+    FROM generate_series(DATE '2013-01-01', DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS t(d)
+    GROUP BY 1
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+rate = pooled[["day_of_week", "crashes"]].merge(exposure, on="day_of_week")
+rate["avg_crashes_per_calendar_day"] = rate["crashes"] / rate["calendar_days"]
+rate.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
+bars = ax.bar(rate["day_of_week"], rate["avg_crashes_per_calendar_day"], color="#3a9278")
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{x:,.1f}" for x in rate["avg_crashes_per_calendar_day"]], padding=3, fontsize=9)
+ax.set_title("Average NYC crashes per calendar weekday, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_ylabel("Average crashes per date")
+ax.set_xlabel("Day of week")
+ax.set_ylim(0, rate["avg_crashes_per_calendar_day"].max() * 1.13)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: each year contributes its own weekday share, showing changes over time.
+annual = by_year.copy()
+annual["annual_total"] = annual.groupby("year")["crashes"].transform("sum")
+annual["share_of_year_crashes_pct"] = annual["crashes"] / annual["annual_total"] * 100
+annual.sort_values(["year", "day_of_week"]).to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.8))
+for day in weekday_order:
+    series = annual[annual["day_of_week"] == day].sort_values("year")
+    ax.plot(series["year"], series["share_of_year_crashes_pct"], marker="o", markersize=3, linewidth=1.5, label=day)
+ax.set_title("Weekday share of NYC crashes by year, 2013–2025")
+ax.set_ylabel("Share of that year's crashes (%)")
+ax.set_xlabel("Year")
+ax.set_xticks(range(2013, 2026, 2))
+ax.grid(alpha=0.22)
+ax.legend(ncol=4, frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="best")
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print("Pooled totals:\n", pooled.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nCalendar-day rates:\n", rate.to_string(index=False))
+print("\nAnnual share extremes:")
+for day in weekday_order:
+    s = annual[annual["day_of_week"] == day]
+    lo, hi = s.loc[s["share_of_year_crashes_pct"].idxmin()], s.loc[s["share_of_year_crashes_pct"].idxmax()]
+    print(f"{day}: {lo.share_of_year_crashes_pct:.2f}% ({lo.year}) to {hi.share_of_year_crashes_pct:.2f}% ({hi.year})")
+print("\nYearly top weekdays:")
+print(annual.loc[annual.groupby("year")["crashes"].idxmax(), ["year", "day_of_week", "crashes"]].to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
